_comment: Transcribed from the in-game customisation screens, captured 2026-08-06 (Steam captures 20260806011221-011900 and 023313-023457). Point cost is the number on the tile; every weapon has 100 points to spend across all slots. Name and description are identical on every weapon that takes it, verified across the eleven assault rifles in that run.
name: PTT Grip Pod

description.text: Allows weapon to be mounted more effectively on the edges of cover and while prone. Slightly reduces recoil at the cost of aim down sights (ADS) accuracy while moving.
